materials.notes: UL ANSI none; no-flow, dust free prepreg for heat sink boards, die cavity boards and rigid-flex bonding, with minimal resin flow. T288 is published as >30 min (unclad) and the dipping test (288 C solder dip) as >600 s. Typical values on the 0.8 mm specimen. The line-up sheet gives Dk and Df by glass style (1027 to 1078, 25-100 um) by SPDR at 1, 5 and 10 GHz.

materials.name: SI10US
materials.notes: Known from its line-up sheet only (the sheet also gives Dk and Df by construction at 1, 5 and 10 GHz and a companion prepreg SI10NSB, not stored). The thickness list holds the nominal thicknesses of the sheet.
